prerequisites: Contents of the Fluid Mechanics lecture (1252)

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basic concepts of Numerical Fluid Mechanics.
Students are able to analyze and solve simple fluid mechanics problems using commercial tools.
Students are also able to implement simple simulation programs in a high-level language.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals: Tensor calculus, stress tensor, Navier-Stokes equation, continuity equation, finite difference method, boundary conditions, grid types, stream function.
Commercial tools: Introduction to flow simulation with a commercial CFD program such as STAR CCM+ or ANSYS CFX.
Software development: Implementation of a CFD program in a higher programming language for simple flow problems such as the Lid-Driven-Cavity or the Backward-Facing-Step Problem.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
